Availability and payment options

Paid support is subject to Founder suitability, capacity, and availability review. International clients may be accepted for online support. After written permission to pay, local clients receive bank-transfer details for APC's Maybank business account or DuitNow QR details. International clients receive bank-transfer details through Wise. Payment details are always sent privately.

1 / 3

Option 01

I'm not sure what support we need.

Use the Free 15-Min First Step Call as a no-cost fit check. It is not a consultation, assessment, diagnostic service, or advice session, and not therapy.

Book Free 15-Min First Step Call

Option 02

I have one focused parent concern.

The RM350 One-Concern Parent Session is a 45-minute online session for one repeated concern, focused pattern review, and one practical next step. The Founder first reviews suitability, capacity, and availability and gives explicit written permission before payment. Local Maybank bank-transfer or DuitNow QR details, or international Wise bank-transfer details, are sent privately only after permission. A request, payment, or proof is not automatic confirmation.

Do not pay unless the Founder first gives you explicit written permission.

Option 03

I'm considering Home Support.

The RM1,800 APC Home Support Programme includes four sessions once every two weeks, a personalised Home Support Plan, WhatsApp clarification throughout the active programme, and one check-in about a month after the final session. The Founder reviews suitability, capacity, and availability before giving individual written permission to pay.

See APC Home Support Programme details

Need something useful right now? Open APC Calm for simple prompts in a difficult moment. Still unsure which support fits? The free call is the simplest place to begin.
